text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing, I come
across
some people looking immensely
excited.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No way! There's going to be a Dee
pop-up?! I
thought he only sold online!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Apparently, he also has pop-ups
every now
and again. I heard there'd be
one around here!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well, if it isn't Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Fuji! You haven't seen any stalls selling

accessories around here, have you?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mean the Dee pop-up? I was
actually just
on my way over there!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Dee is a popular accessory designer.
Legend has
it he once sold out a new
release in just one
minute.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Save the explanations for later! Let's
move!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No way, it's really here! I chose the
perfect time
to check the website!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I guess so. His accessories have to grow
on you a
bit, but once he gets his hooks
in you, that's it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That chain earring is one of his, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How do you know that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I enjoy dressing in a variety of
styles, so
I'm
always checking out different tastes.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No kidding...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh, he's selling the ear cuffs!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, those are the ones people say sold
out in a
minute! The silver rings next to
them are also very
rare!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!
So, do you know what those are right
next to
them?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's the limited-edition
anti-eyebrow and
eyebrow set! That's
the—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This takes me back. I went and got the
piercing
done professionally the very
day it arrived.
choice_data_list: Oh, that's just like Shakur's eyeb...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I still haven't got an anti-eyebrow
piercing done
yet, but I'm definitely
going to one day!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, there are even some items for sale
today
only! And the design!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me! It matches that necklace
he used to
sell, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!
It does, right?! I knew it!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised you knew that. You must
be a
hardcore fan!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm honored by the compliment!
But I just
happen to have one, so it just
clicked.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You might actually be able to pull it off
as well.
It's limited edition, so this might
be your only chance to get your hands
on it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur is in a good mood from start
to finish,
and Fuji Kiseki and I have a
good time shopping
with her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I bought more than I expected!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I might've gotten a little carried away,
actually. I
spent a lot, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess. It was a necessary
expense, so no
regrets.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you found one you like!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you consider the effect that having
these will
have on my performance...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It was a freakin' bargain, if anything.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It was a freakin' bargain, if anything.
choice_data_list: Which one are you putting on first?
Which one are you putting on first?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say it makes it sound less

convincing...
choice_data_list: Which one are you putting on first?
Which one are you putting on first?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Meh... I guess it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shopping with Air Shakur has turned out
to be an
extremely valuable experience!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Does it matter? And why do I have to
tell you
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's the only answer I get out of her,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I notice Air Shakur trying out each of her
new
accessories over the next few days
and looking
pleased.
